events.title: The brief confirms electrical and mechanical requirements, leaving critical power topology selection between §4.2 and App. B for engineering confirmation.
The engine placed the server racks across rows R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, and R6, establishing a standard hall layout that remains within clearance limits.
The enumerated options all comply with R01 while spanning cheaper to more expensive configurations with varying failover headroom.

Hydraulic zones Z1, Z2, and Z3 are sized with N+1 redundancy, with Z1 served by CDU-1, CDU-2, and CDU-3. Zone Z2 is served by CDU-4, CDU-5, and CDU-6, while zone Z3 is served by CDU-7, CDU-8, and CDU-9.
Applying rule R15 swaps TX-2500 for in-stock TX-3150 across candidate topologies, bringing lead times well within the tender limit at the expense of higher prospective fault currents.
Re-evaluation of topologies 2N and DR shows that prospective fault levels increased following the equipment swap but remain within allowable limits.
